messages:
Maria Chen: Quick async check — stitching v2 compatibility across SDK/runtime/infra. Who's actively owning the final canary? Need to confirm canary window + rollback plan.
Jon Patel: @Maria I can own the canary window config. proposing 2-hour canary on Tuesday 9–11 UTC, 50% traffic slice. If regressions hit >1% error rate we rollback.
Alex Gomez: @Jon — runtime is ready for that window, but we need the SDK pin for the new header change (x-rw-api-version). PR #4782 has the header and a small telemetry bump.
Priya Rao: infra ok to route 50% to canary, but we need the cert rotation to finish first. ETA today EOD. If that slips, push canary to Wednesday.
Sam Lee: SDK release team — we're green on unit tests but need a final integration smoke from eng-runtime. @Alex can you run a 10-min smoke hitting the SDK canary artifacts?
Alex Gomez: will run smoke at 16:30 PT. I'll post logs. If any 503s show up >0.2% we pause.
Tasha Ivanov: evals flagged a small quality regression on long-chat flows with the v2 tokenizer change. Not blocking canary but please add prompt set A to regression alerting.
Maria Chen: good catch @Tasha — add that eval to the monitoring hook. @Sam add eval trigger to SDK CI so we fail on quality regressions.
Sam Lee: noted. I'll add a post-release job that runs prompt set A and fails if self-BLEU drops >0.03.
ci-bot: Build passed — SDK canary artifact: rw-sdk-0.9.1-canary. SHA: abc1234. Dry-run deploy queued.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for rw-sdk-0.9.1-canary -> runtime-canary-01. Route: 50% slice. Rolling in 3 batches.
Alex Gomez: smoke run complete: 10m, 0.05% 5xx, 0.01% token error. Logs: https://logs.internal/abc123 (truncated)
Jon Patel: looks healthy. Starting to ramp to full 50% now.
Priya Rao: cert rotation finished early, canary unaffected.
Tasha Ivanov: running prompt set A now — small regression detected at minute 22, score -0.035. Marking as triage.
Maria Chen: decision: continue canary but enable strict alerting and shorten window to 90m. Owners: @Jon canary ops, @Sam SDK rollback ready, @Alex runtime fallback implemented.
Sam Lee: preparing rollback PR (revert header change) ready if we cross thresholds.
Alex Gomez: runtime fallback ready: auto-route to v1-compatible cluster on matching failures.
Jon Patel: noted. I'll update the rotation policy doc and leave a checklist in the canary thread.
Maria Chen: thanks all. If nothing else in 2 hours I'll post final status. :thumbsup:
